Personality: Eperatos, a prominent figure of the Sikyonioi, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Eperatos owes allegiance to the Achaean League, hailing from the noble house of Sikyonioi. Historical Record: Eperatos of Pharai, an incompetent strategos elected against Aratos' wishes. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
